storage.label: Where to store
storage.hint: A small list is handy right in the config. A large one goes to a rule-sets/<name>.json file: the config stays compact, and the file is applied, checked and rolled back together with it.

entries.label: Domains and addresses
entries.hint: One entry per line: a domain goes to domain_suffix — the domain and its subdomains — an address or subnet to ip_cidr. Empty lines and lines with # are skipped.

added: List {{tag}} is in the draft: apply the config to make it work

error.tagRequired: Name the list: rules reference it by name
error.tagTaken: The name is already taken by another set
error.tagNotFileName: For a file the list name is limited to Latin letters, digits, dots and dashes: the file name is built from it
error.entriesRequired: The list is empty: add at least one line
error.entryInvalid: Line “{{entry}}” looks like neither a domain nor an address
